sentences.text: Present: Mr. Ashwani Kaundal, Advocate, for the appellant.
Mr. Ashok Sood, Senior Advocate, with Mr. Abhishek Banta, Advocate, for respondents No.1 to 5.
Respondent No.6 is state to have expired.
CMP No. 10284 of 2025 in FAO(MVA) No.398 of This application has been filed on behalf of applicant/respondent No.1 for release of remaining amount of compensation to her.

It is apt to record that vide order dated 24.08.2016 and 22.05.2019, compensation amount i.e.,
Rs.1,50,000/- & Rs.50,000/- already stands released in favour of applicant/respondent No.1.
The entire amount of respondents No.2 and 3 also stands released vide order dated 04.05.2016.

Learned counsel for the non appellant/Insurance Company has opposed, the release of amount of compensation with the submissions that there is every likelihood of reduction of amount of compensation at the time of final adjudication of the appeal and therefore, the application deserves to be dismissed.

Considering the rival contentions of the parties and balancing their interest at this stage,
Rs.50,000/- out of the share for which applicant/respondent No.1 is entitled be released in favour of applicant/respondent No.1, alongwith up-to-date proportionate interest; by remitting the same in her bank account mentioned in Para No.2 of the application.
Photo copy of front page of passbook is also on record.
The present application stands disposed of, in the aforesaid terms.
List along with main for hearing on 12.08.2025, the date already fixed.

(Vivek Singh Thakur) Judge June 05, 2025 (Shamsh Tabrez)
Shriram General Insurance Company Ltd. vs . Sushma & Ors.
